title: STNFS with 150k pool, both-bars alpha (5.15, 0.85), theta 2881/8000, slacks (295, 226), UDUP 0.65, pr sub-bins, reopt plan: 121.08658

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the complete STNFS algorithm in proof.md and DESCENT.md with the REFINEMENT.md refinements, 99.9% ECM, X2 = 2^64, theta = 2881/8000 collection on a 150,000-draw pool (proof.md), the measured record route and the STORAGE.md/row_tail.c kernels returns Q satisfying e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P, with success at least 0.3966 (and hence at least 0.39) under disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (with H4u: at least 88% of the filtered matrix row weight is +-1 entries). It computes two GT logarithms and returns Q=[a]Q0, handling z=1 directly. All classical work is bounded by a global meter at 2^121.08658 dense-Fp12 units, C=20,000 instructions, with upper-rounded ledger rows summing to <= 2^121.08658. ECM succeeds with 99.9% per prime; X2 = 2^64; theta=2881/8000 (6628 rows, a-radius 869) with slacks (295, 226), allowance 1.0263, alpha (5.15, 0.85), primes in [2^63, 2^64) charged twice, records routed at 10.01 each and re-read at 7.003: collection <= 2^120.9254 units. The polynomials, factor-base bound, filtering, kernels and target remain those of the cited source; the 62-node descent plan of REFINEMENT.md/refinement.json (coordinate search with joint moves, 45 entries differ from the base plan, boot unchanged) is evaluated at UDUP = 0.65 and THIN_MAX 85. Linear algebra (STORAGE.md, row_tail.c: 20.7 instructions per sparse entry, 2,710 per row for six-limb transfers, combination and the reduction mod r, 97 per dense term, 420 per further 9-limb reduction, N = 1.096 x 0.0471 U, Block Wiedemann blocks (19, 4)) is <= 2^117.7103 units, generator <= 2^107.1997. Descent credits UDUP = 0.65 distinct relations per raw relation (relation-weighted E[shat/m]/pr >= 0.7067 boot / >= 1.175 nodes against the integrated pr, uniform cells; 1.06/4.70 sextile-pr campaign floors divided by the 1.5x/4x boost caps), integrates pr over 24+10 norm sub-bins (boost capped 4x/1.5x), forces discard only up to 2^90, and keeps 18 boot relations. Expected two-log work is bounded by 2^113.610; the two-log meter is 2^114.343; Markov abort probability is <= 0.6016516. Other upper bounds are boot failure 3.600e-04 per log, expected nodes 2^16.08, node abort 2^-11.22 and repeats 2^-10.70, with 2/r statistical distance charged. All preprocessing, failed attempts, advice, arithmetic, transfers, sorting, verification and output are included; nothing amortized. Numerical-certificate construction receives an extra 2^50-unit allowance. Memory is at most 2^105 bytes. Source smoothness and production extrapolations stay explicit heuristics. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit of recorded full-recurrence evidence, upward-rounded ledger and success, unchanged prime-window endpoints, and nonzero lower/upper integration controls. Does not rerun the full recurrence.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py) to mean weight 100 and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.88) and U/N. Optional (the hosted initial run is the bounded audit). Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).
Optional full recomputation of certificates, region, ledger, retention, ECM, descent and declared bounds (about 50 s natively; longer when emulated).
